core_conclusion: Within the reduced same-spectrum model, removing the inversion-odd registry sector eliminates the global directional response, whereas exact spatial inversion swaps the static thresholds and reverses the deterministic winding/current.

caption: Figure 3. Same-spectrum symmetry interventions isolate the directional mechanism within the reduced model. (a) Intervention definitions: the original landscape retains the inversion-odd sector, matched symmetrization removes it while keeping the same 2H spectral content, and exact spatial inversion reverses it. This panel is schematic. (b) At theta=1.5 deg, the original global thresholds are split, the matched symmetrized thresholds are degenerate, and exact inversion swaps the two thresholds. (c) The deterministic winding changes from the original (1,-1) state to zero under matched symmetrization and to (-1,1) after exact inversion. (d) Static and dynamic symmetry-contract residuals are at numerical-precision scales. These are mathematical mechanism controls and do not establish a physical polarization-reversal law.
